notes: The remaining two wires of ECONOMY-INHERITANCE-SPEC, behind the same configurable toggle as the ERP (ECONOMY_INHERITANCE_ENABLED, default 0, flipped per instance in the Economy panel's Inheritance view or via set_economy_inheritance): - 1c — the risk-free centralises. With the toggle on, the economy's risk_free_10y_pct replaces the per-name fred:DGS10 fetch in pricing/context.js — one central value, at parity (the economy carries the same DGS10 print), the source line renamed so a reader sees where it came from. The deliberate exception: a name whose per-name fetch had degraded to the fmp:trea
